paragraphs.dominant_move: open with the disaster damage and NGO capability need
pair simple capacity constraints with linear programming
identify Drone G as the strongest transport option
couple capability models with geographic information
close with supply duration, coverage, scheduling, and routing
establish the timeliness of emergency services
couple capability evaluation with AHP siting factors
promise fast route planning through an improved greedy method

global_organization_chain: The summary starts with Hurricane Maria and HELP's response need, then advances through transport capability, reconnaissance capability, geographic siting, lambda tradeoff, multiple containers, schedule, route, and bounded case outcomes.
The introduction makes four deliverables scannable and preserves their dependency order: packing, capability-aware siting, payload configuration, and route planning.
The first technical staircase solves nested MED-to-bay and drone/bay-to-container geometry before any capability or geographic claim is made.
Feasible medicine configurations become TC, daily packed volume, Days, and TCI, which screen E and G and define the container payload objective.
After a Monte Carlo packing result, the report changes scale from physical containers to a 100-meter-order map through a camera viewing-radius argument.
Seven normalized feature layers, hospital medicine weights, distance kernels, coverage normalization, TCI, RCI, and separate AHP weights build TI and RI surfaces in an inspectable order.
Lambda enters only after separate TI and RI surfaces exist, turning a two-objective siting problem into a configurable multiplicative utility and continuous fleet mixture.
For multiple containers, each selected site changes later medical and road features; those sites and fleets then feed medicine-scheme enumeration and max-min hospital scheduling.
The fixed payload schedule becomes the priority input for individual and fleet greedy routing, whose route maps produce the 59.86 percent road-coverage claim.
The report perturbs AHP weights, separates source-authored strengths and weaknesses, reassembles the system answer, and translates it into a CEO memo and software frame.

The final pass records geometry, probability, camera, range, AHP, integer-realization, energy, route, sensitivity, and reference warnings without replacing positive language, organization, model, equation, or visual evidence.

main_argument_chains.claim: Transport capability is built from nested physical feasibility before any drone type or container configuration is selected.
support_steps: six orientations and six cut orders
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Use the E/G packing only after closing non-overlap, unresolved linkage constraints, Monte Carlo arithmetic, and exact optimality evidence.

main_argument_chains.claim: Reconnaissance capability and geography are introduced as a separate chain rather than folded into transport capacity.
support_steps: separate TI and RI AHP weights
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Treat TI and RI surfaces as conditional proxies until camera, range, raster, coefficient, and AHP evidence is reproducible.

main_argument_chains.claim: The single-site decision preserves transport and reconnaissance until a user preference lambda scalarizes them.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Show the feasible integer TI-RI frontier and decision-switch thresholds before treating a continuous-share lambda optimum as a packable fleet.

main_argument_chains.claim: Multiple containers are selected by updating served medical and road features after each site.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Keep the result labeled a sequential heuristic until a joint multi-site baseline and sensitivity to one-third and r0 are reported.

main_argument_chains.claim: The fleet plan closes the analytical chain by turning selected drone counts into medicine schemes, max-min hospital service, and delivery-first survey routes.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Interpret two-month supply and 59.86 percent coverage only after energy, sortie time, return, landing, unloading, charging, maintenance, road-graph, and coverage-denominator closure.

main_argument_chains.claim: The paper returns to the stakeholder through local AHP sensitivity, a source-authored appraisal, a system conclusion, and a CEO memo with adjustable options.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Retain the memo's configurability while replacing broad robustness and field-readiness language with end-to-end uncertainty, verified sources, and operational tests.

warnings.warning: The three-dimensional integer formulation constrains assignment, orientation, and containment but has no pairwise non-overlap constraint and no explicit nonnegative lower-coordinate bound, so geometrically intersecting goods may satisfy the printed model.

The container program cites Equation (??) twice for the bay-drone equality and one-H-per-container conditions. The prose reveals the intended relationships, but unresolved references prevent a closed, auditable printed program.
For p_hit=10^-5, the stated one-billion simulations would make 1-(1-p)^N essentially one, not 0.999954. The reported probability, exponent, and run count are numerically inconsistent.
The step from a two-megapixel/1080P camera to delta_theta=0.003 rad is underived: angular resolution also requires pixel dimensions and optical field of view, and camera/terrain effects are omitted.
DIS uses no-cargo flight time and assumes payload does not change range; it is not clear whether DIS is one-way or round-trip, so transport and reconnaissance feasibility may be overstated.

RCI uses DIS squared divided by packed drone-plus-bay volume as reconnaissance capability, but this proxy omits sensor quality, road topology, route continuity, viewing overlap, and return-flight feasibility.
The prose defines CR as the ratio CI/RI0 but then writes (lambda_max-n)/(n-1), which is the standard CI formula, as CR. Reported CI and CR values must be recomputed from the displayed matrices.
The nonlinear program optimizes continuous volume shares v(i); no integer realization constraint proves that the selected proportions fit whole drones, bays, and one tethered H inside a container.

The multi-location method is called dynamic programming, but the printed method is a sequential reweighting heuristic with assumed one-third demand reduction and no Bellman state, value recursion, or global optimality argument.

The max-min duration can exceed two months while charging/generation equipment is explicitly excluded. The schedule omits battery cycles, flight time, landing, unloading, recharging, maintenance, and replenishment constraints.
Only one AHP weight is perturbed at a time. Small local location changes do not establish strong robustness of packing, range, integer scheduling, routing, data, or the complete end-to-end decision.

TCI is a container-volume duration proxy computed with fractional equivalent drones and one homogeneous drone type; it does not validate a mixed-fleet, repeated-flight, route-time, or energy-feasible deployment.

request_body_guard.transport_finding: HTTP 413 is an nginx ingress rejection before model processing. Base64 expands binary bytes and the whole accumulated request is measured together. Q126 therefore used eight JPEG proxies no larger than 450000 bytes, at most one image per tool call, no original full-page PNG, no complete session JSONL or base64 output, and text/hash checks after the eighth proxy.
